english.title: Purchase / acquire pump action/ self load rifle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, purchased or acquired

(A)_[a self-loading]_
(B)_[a pump-action]_

rifled gun other than one which was chambered for 0.5588 centimetre (.22") rim-fire cartridges, namely **(..SPECIFY RIFLED GUN..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(ab) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Calibre expressed in metric terms following EC Directive on Units of Measurement which came into force on 1st January 1995 and the Units of Measurement Regulations 1995 which came into force on 1st October 1995.
(ii) This does not apply to weapons prohibited by section 5(1)(aba ) - see H6132, H6133, H6134 and H6135.
(iii) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H6124, H6126 and H6127.
(iv) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
